research_question: Do independent dimensionless analytic reference models satisfy the M00--M04 Euler, pressure, strain, VA-projection and spherical-flux identities within predetermined tolerances?
objective: Qualify numerical diagnostic operators using four SHA-locked papers and analytical controls; do not infer SST particle/gravity validity.
null_hypothesis: H0: at least one analytic identity, source hash, or native FP64 parity condition fails at its preregistered threshold.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: all eligible M00--M04 local mathematical benchmarks converge and strict CPU FP64 parity matches the Python reference.
assumptions: Smooth incompressible three-dimensional velocity fields where analytic benchmarks apply.
Periodic Fourier fields for Helmholtz projection; nonzero wave numbers inverted, zero-mode removed.
M04 spherical flux identity is checked on linear velocity fields only, not a universal turbulent flux statistic.
Paper PDFs are literature/provenance; independent numerical providers or PKLSA stability are not claimed.

equations.dimensional_check: Q_A and omega^2 both T^-2; f,m dimensionless
vorticity source T^-2; spatial operators cancel appropriately

equations.purpose: Zhang-Yao angular flux for linear fields
equations.dimensional_check: ell^2 times T^-3 gives L^2 T^-3

observables.definition: 4 file SHA-256 matches; framework 92/92 manifest matches
max divergence and Euler+Poisson reference residual
pressure source and Schur wedge residual

steps.operation: Verify four included PDF SHA-256 and original framework package-manifest files
Evaluate three Landreman configurations by central-difference Euler residuals
Evaluate shear/balanced vortex and preregistered random tensor wedge
Evaluate periodic VA projection and direct sphere quadrature
Compile dedicated double C++ tensor diagnostics and compare against Python without fallback

falsification_criteria.criterion: Any PDF hash mismatch or framework file hash mismatch
M01 divergence >=3e-7, momentum >=2e-7 or pressure-source residual >=3e-6
M02 analytic wedge violation >1e-10 or balanced source >1e-12
M03 projection error >=1e-8 or mean enstrophy source >=1e-9; M04 quadrature relative error >=1e-12

edge_cases: zero grad tensor normalized f undefined
predictions: M01--M04 are algebraic/numerical controls and do not predict SST masses or gravity.
Balanced vortex has Q_A=0 but positive vortex stretching; gradients alone cannot infer 3D physical confinement.
